c.title: 20 genres · 1,000 ranked games on the site
c.detail: Fifty unique standalone games per genre, with no pins or personal exclusions. This Page keeps the top ten per genre; the site has all fifty. The 15 Upcoming titles remain separate.

c.title: Previews, tools and duplicate app aliases removed
c.detail: Removed The Riftbreaker: Prologue, the Star Fetchers pilot, Ithya and Spirit City productivity tools from the previous Page list. All twenty genres were checked and backfilled. Isometric ARPGs require both official Action RPG and Isometric Steam tags.

c.title: Ten cards per page, five pages per genre
c.detail: The site opens with highlights and genre tiles. Hash routes preserve page numbers; search and optional sale/Verified/free filters cover all 1,000 ranked games. Compact JSON and lazy genre chunks keep first load small; screenshots load only when opened.

c.title: Data-driven, without guaranteed places
c.detail: Confidence-weighted review ranking uses source review totals. A game that falls outside its genre's top fifty is not listed. Prices and review data that could not be verified are labelled rather than invented.
